motor: Kraken X44 standard trapezoidal commutation, WCP-0941 with Talon FX
fit: Endpoint-defined linear torque-speed and torque-current equations; interior CSV rows withheld from coefficient extraction and checked numerically. This published curve itself is linear, not raw individual test repetitions.
domain: 12 V full-voltage envelope, 0 to 7757.6047386285445 rpm, nonnegative motoring torque; optional specified stator-current cap. Outside-envelope margins fail. No partial-duty electrical predictions.
independent_validation: Interior manufacturer-curve reproduction, rounded WCP 41 A/393 W/~80.4% cross-check, analytic work/kinetic-energy and domain checks. These are software/specification checks, not independent experimental validation of controller, mission efficiencies, gearbox or rover.

mass_sources.drive: base 261 g + 4:1 133 g + two 5:1 138 g each + 3-inch shaft 27 g = 697 g
mass_sources.drum: PROVISIONAL 753 g three-stage inventory budget: base 261 g + three 155 g cartridges + 27 g shaft; ratio/stages not frozen
mass_sources.limitations: Spline adapter substitutions, external mounting, hardware changes and exact installed shafts require a weighed BOM. Stage load ratings and X44 interface compatibility not verified. No fitted gearbox mass-versus-ratio function.

hardware_validation_status: Not experimentally validated. Current limits, thermal duty and continuous gearbox ratings undecided.
model_usage: Torque-speed envelope and optional torque-current cap only. Mission energy uses separate provisional combined efficiencies (drive 0.72, drum 0.70); these are not fitted to this CSV.
